what: The machine-readable half of the P1-28 closing package. It names ONE commit as the phase's code candidate and records every measurement taken against it, with the provenance of each. docs/phase-1/phase-1-28/evidence/closure-evidence.md is the prose half and must state the same candidate; scripts/ci/build-p1-28-evidence-manifest.mjs refuses a disagreement between the two.
why: P1-27 shipped a closing page that pinned a head 47 commits behind the tree it described, and it went on reading like evidence because nothing compared the claim with the repository. A closing value that names no head is not a measurement of anything. Every figure below therefore carries the head it was taken at and the artefact it came from.
whatThisIsNot: This is not a tamper-proof seal. The digests in evidence-manifest.json remove SILENT revision, not revision. It is ALSO not an Owner acceptance and not a closure record: the phase is OPEN and `OWNER ACCEPTANCE` has neither been asked for nor returned. What it IS is a package whose hosted half has been taken in full: all eleven bindings — the five tiers, hostedCi, CodeQL, dependency security, browser-by-project, the production build and the database reproof — cite PR CI run 32282436188 at 9d00a454, where all 21 checks are green. That head DESCENDS from the candidate and its apps/** and supabase/** are COMPUTED byte-identical to it, so each binding says so with `describesProductIdenticalSuccessor` rather than claiming to be the candidate. The unit and web figures are additionally COMPUTED against the run ledger at 89c474aa, measured at the named successor adf063b8. `pendingHostedBindings.bindings` is EMPTY by derivation, not by assertion: the gate rebuilds the set from the documents' own headSha fields and refuses a difference in either direction.
